item.description: After nearly three decades in New York, photographer Jacob Blickenstaff is returning to St. Louis with an exhibition that feels both deeply personal and quietly radical. Show of Hands, opening March 6 at Clayton’s Bruno David Gallery, turns away from celebrity faces and toward the physical labor of making music—fingers, palms, gestures, touch.
